facts.text: I want advice for my YouTube channel.
My YouTube channel is about going on a journey from art hobbyist to professional artist.
I want to create a welcome video for my channel that shows viewers why they want to be on my channel.
I want top searched keywords around going from hobbyist to professional artist.
I want to make a video on the topic "Art techniques".
I want a video script for "Creating Stunning Art with Basic Techniques: How to Make the Most of Your Skills".
I want the script in a special outline format called [ FORMAT ].

My [ FORMAT ] includes: a hook cold open, an open splash front bumper with music and logo (5 seconds), a short introduction, a teaser with an open loop, main content, a question CTA to like/comment/subscribe, a teaser content delivery step, a final CTA to go to my website to subscribe to my art newsletter, and a "watch this video next" recommendation.
I want [ FORMAT ] written for the title "Unlocking the Secrets of Art Techniques: Insider Tips from Professional Artists".

keyphrases: art hobbyist to professional artist journey
open splash front bumper music and logo
